name: com.tmapmobility.tmap.automotive.voiceassistant.edith.api.EdithBroadcastReceiver
description: When Edith or the car interface broadcasts a navigation or voice-recognition command, the TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK forwards location, route, waypoint, and guidance requests to TMAP. It also mutes or unmutes navigation speech while voice recognition is active.
disableEffect: Edith voice commands can no longer start or control TMAP routes, and speech-state changes will not be handled.
